rules.description: Destructive account deletion is prohibited in this reference implementation.
rules.reason: Destructive account deletion is outside the authorised operating boundary.

rules.description: Demonstration transfers above S$50,000 are blocked.
rules.reason: The requested amount exceeds the configured demonstration risk limit.

rules.description: Transfers of S$1,000 or more require an independent finance approver.
rules.reason: The action is financially consequential and requires independent approval.

rules.description: Low-value demonstration transfers are permitted for authorised finance operators.
rules.reason: The action is within the configured low-value operating boundary.

rules.description: Authorised operators may create demonstration notes.
rules.reason: The action is low consequence and covered by an authorised capability contract.

rules.description: Authorised operators may use the isolated local browser demonstration capability.
rules.reason: The action is constrained to a local allowlisted origin and fixed selectors.
